name: Thran
description: The ancient empire in which Yawgmoth was born and whose capital was Halcyon.

timeline.summary: Ancient artifacts and machines of war of the Thran Empire are discovered on Terisiare.
timeline.quote: Ancient artifacts of the Thran Empire are discovered on the continent of Terisiare

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Brothers' War erupts between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone, with ancient Thran machines used in battle.
timeline.quote: an epic war between Urza and Mishra for control of both halves of the stone

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza improves on Thran's ornithopter design.
timeline.quote: "It has been my honor to improve on Thran's original design.

citation.text: Ornithopter (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: On Koilos Xantcha and Ratepe discover that the Phyrexians were Thran who rebelled and were cast out of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians were actually Thran that rebelled and were then cast out from Dominaria.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth usurps the Thran Empire, leading to civil war and the empire's collapse.
timeline.quote: However, a man named Yawgmoth managed to usurp most of the power in the empire, which led to both civil war and war

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Thran Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza writes in his journal that the rig shows Thran unity of vision.
timeline.quote: Every device in the rig is evidence of Thran enlightenment.

citation.text: Thran Lens (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza says he improved the Thran's ornithopter design in his apprenticeship.
timeline.quote: It has been my honor to improve on the Thran's original design.

citation.text: Ornithopter (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takara engineers the crew's escape; Gerrard's band finds Thran ruins, meets dryads and fights a mechanical war engine.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Takara engineers the crew's escape.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Thran migrate from the east and carve out an empire covering two-thirds of Terisiare.
timeline.quote: The Thran came from the east and carved out an empire that covered two-thirds of Terisiare

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Structure and Governance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Almost all the Thran are killed or flee to Phyrexia; Rebbec closes the portal.
timeline.quote: the portal to that plane was then closed in a final defiant act by Rebbec.

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The remaining Thran cities are bombed with death clouds on Yawgmoth's standing orders.
timeline.quote: The remaining Thran cities were then all similarly bombed with death clouds on standing orders from Yawgmoth.

citation.text: "Thran Empire", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Halcyon survivors flee to Phyrexia and become the first Phyrexians; the empire falls.
timeline.quote: becoming the first true Phyrexians

citation.text: "Thran-Phyrexian War", section "The aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth rises among the Thran and starts the Thran-Phyrexian War.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth comes to power among the Thran .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Time of the Thran (Up to c. -5000 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ] [ 30 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Halcyon the Thran Empire falls and Yawgmoth is trapped on Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the Thran Empire is destroyed, and Yawgmoth is trapped on Phyrexia

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Time of the Thran (Up to c. -5000 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ] [ 30 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The excavator opens a sealed Thran workshop, and Karn finds a diagram of the sylex and a clay tablet with matching symbols.
timeline.quote: a diagram of the sylex painted on parchment

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth approaches the Sphere on a flying caravel; the garrison's bombards cripple it and the Phyrexians abandon it as it crashes.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians were forced to abandon the vessel

citation.text: "Battle of the Null Sphere", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians swarm the garrison and slaughter Thran and Phyrexians alike.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth sent his Phyrexians to swarm the garrison.

citation.text: "Battle of the Null Sphere", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed visits Glacian; Yawgmoth walks in and talks her into aiding him, and she gifts him an amulet.
timeline.quote: Dyfed fell for the charming words of Yawgmoth and agreed to find a plane where Yawgmoth could build a paradise for all the Thran.

citation.text: "Dyfed", section "Aiding Yawgmoth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix stabs Glacian with a powerstone, giving him phthisis; Rebbec recalls Yawgmoth from exile to heal him.
timeline.quote: Rebbec , used her influence in the council to recall the healer Yawgmoth from his exile

citation.text: "Glacian", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth's serum fails on Glacian, who grows paranoid and develops multiple personality disorder.
timeline.quote: it had no effect on Glacian

citation.text: "Glacian", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Clear-minded, Glacian's essence convinces Rebbec to unify the halves and close the portal to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: he convinced Rebbec to unify the halves and use them to close the portal to Phyrexia forever

citation.text: "Glacian", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Thran Civil War consolidates Halcyon's position as capital and ends with the exile of Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: culminated in the exile of Yawgmoth

citation.text: "Time of the Thran", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth is brought back from exile to heal the artificer Glacian, and the Thran-Phyrexian War begins over diverging visions.
timeline.quote: brought back from exile to heal the great artificer Glacian

citation.text: "Time of the Thran", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The war ends in the collapse of Halcyon, the annihilation of the Thran Empire and the dispersal of its people.
timeline.quote: The war culminated in the collapse of Halcyon, the annihilation of the Thran Empire, and the dispersal of its people.

citation.text: "Time of the Thran", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Halcyon becomes the Thran capital and the Thran Civil War breaks out.
timeline.quote: The Thran Civil War breaks out - a power struggle between the elite imperialists and republican commoners

citation.text: "Timeline/The Thran", section "c. -5115 to -5000 AR". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Battle of the Null Sphere", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
